Subject: 5/5 - Faster than promised, and they actually read the drawing

We ordered two parts from Arroyo in late October for our near-IR camera: a camera-to-dewar adapter plate and a light baffle tube, both 6061-T6 with black anodize (PO 26-41187, $2,840 including a $300 rush setup fee). The camera is going to the Hale Telescope at Palomar for a run on November 18, so the schedule mattered.

They quoted 21 days. The parts were delivered 9 days after we placed the PO. A large vendor had quoted us about six weeks for similar work, so Arroyo was the obvious choice, and it paid off.

The drawing check is the reason I trust them. I made a units mistake on the bolt circle on sheet 2 of the plate drawing. Ruben at Arroyo caught it before they cut anything, because the number didn't match the other dimensions, and he emailed me to confirm. Without that check the screws would have landed inside the bore. I confirmed the fix the same day. Many shops would have machined what was written. These folks checked it and told us.

When the plate arrived, I did a fit test on the dewar. All eight screws went in without forcing. Flatness across the face was under 0.01 mm on our dial indicator. The baffle threads ran smoothly, and in a dark test with the lab lights on and a 300-second dark frame, the baffle showed no light leak compared with the closed dewar. The anodize was even with no bare spots, and an inspection sheet came with the parts.

Ruben also drove the parts to Robinson himself, at no charge, on his way to another stop. I didn't expect that from a vendor, and it saved us a day.

Plan for quote turnaround, since replies can take several days. But for precision aluminum parts that need to be right the first time, Arroyo is my first call now. I'd support adding them to the preferred vendor list.
